item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 03 September 2026(Thursday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(Subic, Castillejos, Olongapo).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(San Antonio, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Botolan, San Felipe, San Narciso, Santa Cruz, Candelaria, Masinloc), Bataan(Dinalupihan, Pilar, Balanga, Abucay, Samal, Orani, Hermosa, Orion, Limay) and Pampanga(Floridablanca, Masantol, Macabebe, Sasmuan, Lubao).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Batangas(Nasugbu), Quezon(General Nakar) and Nueva Ecija(General Tinio, San Antonio, Gapan, San Isidro, Cabiao, Penaranda, San Leonardo, Jaen, Zaragoza, Gabaldon, Palayan, Laur, Santa Rosa, Licab, Aliaga, Cabanatuan, Cuyapo, Nampicuan, Guimba) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate rains affecting Bulacan, Bataan(Bagac, Mariveles, Morong), Zambales(Iba, Palauig), Pampanga(Porac, Apalit, Minalin, Santa Rita, Guagua, Bacolor, Angeles, San Fernando, San Simon, Santo Tomas, Mexico, San Luis, Candaba, Mabalacat, Arayat, Santa Ana, Magalang), Tarlac(Bamban, Capas, San Jose), Metro Manila(Caloocan, Malabon, Navotas, Valenzuela, Quezon City, Makati, Mandaluyong, San Juan, Pasay, Pateros, Marikina, Manila, Pasig), Rizal(Rodriguez, San Mateo, Antipolo) and Cavite(Ternate, Naic) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
